name: korean-ux-writing
description: Review Korean UI copy in the context of the entire user journey, resolve meaning problems, then refine the wording.

interface.longDescription: For teams reviewing Korean product interfaces: read the user journey, check what users can understand before acting, and refine existing Korean UI copy using published UX and Korean-language references. Preserve other languages and foreign-language spans. Report missing context and unresolved flow problems separately from completed copy edits. Requires desktop access to the product files; includes native audit tools for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Agent walkthroughs are not participant usability tests.
defaultPrompt: 프론트엔드의 전체 사용자 흐름을 읽고 한국어 문구가 목적과 실제 동작에 맞는지 검토한 뒤 다듬어 줘.
